acceptanceCriteria.text: Review Pages generation installs only its required dependency surface or proves with measurement that the root install is already the minimal safe path.
OCR delegate remains pinned and invoked through the same supported contract.
Frozen/immutable dependency resolution is preserved; no floating install is introduced.
Existing Review Pages tests and a real workflow generation run pass.
No Mottainai runtime/MCP dependency is pulled in solely for Review Pages generation unless explicitly required and documented.
Generated review package bytes remain semantically equivalent for fixed fixtures.
The change does not alter trusted publication permissions or PR-content security boundaries.

issue.title: chore: minimize Review Pages dependency installation
